cross_verification.note_en: The FSM Embassy's official FAQ (fsmembassy.fm) confirms that no visa is required to visit FSM — a valid passport, sufficient funds, and proof of onward travel are sufficient for a 30-day stay; longer stays require a separate 'entry permit' from the FSM Department of Justice, Division of Immigration, not a 'visa' per se. No photo specification is published for entry permits in this FAQ. A related Department of Justice entry-permit PDF form (fsmemb.or.jp/.../permit.pdf) could not be parsed by the fetch tool (binary/encoded stream data), so no photo technical fields could be verified for this document type. This DB entry may itself be a category mismatch (FSM issues 'entry permits', not 'visas') but the DB was not altered per instructions.
